THE FLAGSHIP EXPERIENCE · A 12-WEEK BUILD

Twelve weeks.
One Anchor.
A generation
built on purpose.

Anchor 12 is the heart of NGG. Every member walks the same twelve weeks — structured missions from The Anchor, weekly mentor sessions at Egbeda or Ayobo, and a record of every promise kept.

HERO-01
The Anchor — front cover
THE ARC

Three movements,
twelve weeks, one runway.

  1. 01

    Identity.

    Define who you are before others define you.

    Weeks 1 – 4. You will write the line you stand on. You will rehearse it until it stops sounding strange in your own mouth.

  2. 02

    Discipline.

    The promises you keep when nobody is watching.

    Weeks 5 – 8. Daily structure. Reading, reflection, movement, mentor check-in. The streak is the point.

  3. 03

    Influence.

    Build a room. Bring people who weren't invited.

    Weeks 9 – 12. Public work, in front of real audiences. Showcase your craft. Earn a Vanguard pin.

BOOK-01
The Anchor — front cover
BOOK-02
Stacked spines
THE FIELD MANUAL

Every mission lives inside the book.

The Anchor is the printed companion to the program. Twelve chapters, one per week. Read the chapter, then run the missions in your dashboard. The work is the point.

  • Read the chapter on Saturday at your centre.
  • Run the missions Monday – Friday.
  • Verify with your mentor on Saturday.
  • Reflect — privately or with the cohort.
